articles.title: Crypto's campaign arm, Fairshake, sets lists of U.S. House favorites it'll spend on
articles.snippet: The super PAC shared a list of more than 30 incumbent candidates it's backing, with about a million dollars going to three names from each party.

articles.title: Crypto PAC announces support for 32 House candidates in US midterms
articles.snippet: Fairshake said it would financially back 32 House candidates who all voted in favor of the CLARITY market structure bill in 2025, as the legislation remains in limbo in the Senate.

articles.title: Advocacy group pushes back on banks’ lawsuit against OCC over charters
articles.snippet: CCI CEO Ji Hun Kim said that the organization “remains confident“ in the OCC’s approval of charters for crypto companies, despite a recent lawsuit and pushback from some lawmakers.
